events: Juice is founded by Henry Tsai and Pranay Jha, two sophomores and former team captains from the Folsom High School robotics club.
Juice wins as NorCal Regional Champions in its rookie season with Winning Alliance partners Kuriosity Robotics and Quixilver.
Juice wins its first Inspire Award at a qualifying tournament and finishes in the Winning Alliance of the NorCal Gold Division.
>- FIRST World Championship Division Finalist Alliance Captain

Juice wins its second NorCal Championship with Winning Alliance partners Kuriosity Robotics and Terrabats. They rank 5th in the Franklin Division qualifying matches with a 9-2 record and captain the fourth seeded alliance, beating the first seed alliance and competing in the division finals.
Juice finishes in the Finalist Alliance of the NorCal Gold Division.
>- Maryland Tech Invitational Semifinalist Alliance Captain
Juice finishes in the Winning Alliance of the NorCal Gold Division and ranks 6th during qualifying matches at their first Maryland Tech Invitational.
